notes: Ultra-premium OS homepage wallpapers. Cyan/sapphire/obsidian brand. Calm left/upper for icons. More refined than stock Windows Bloom — cinematic lighting, physical materials, no purple haze, no text/logo/UI.

prompts.name: Cyan Orbit
prompts.prompt: Ultra-premium 16:9 OS desktop wallpaper for a modern Windows alternative called DevOS. Deep ink navy studio. Soft luminous cyan orbital glass rings and tiny bright nodes on the right. Vast calm empty left for desktop icons. Photoreal volumetric light, subtle film grain, midnight navy and cyan only. No text, no logo, no UI, no purple.
